philippines.title: Pangasinan folk fight to save vanishing fishing ground
philippines.description:
(First of two parts) SUAL, PANGASINAN—Birds circling above the calm waters surrounding Cabalitian Island are a familiar sight, their silhouettes dotting the blue expanse. Along its narrow beach, waves lap gently against the shore, while forested mountains rise behind the community, lending the island a quiet, seemingly untouched beauty. Beneath this peaceful landscape, however, a growing dispute threatens the livelihood of fishermen who have depended on these waters for generations. For residents of Barangay Cabalitian, the sea is more than a scenic view. It is their fishing ground, workplace and for many families, their last remaining source of income. Residents recalled […]...
